description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints for managing 'restaurants' in a food delivery platform. It includes routes for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting restaurant records, with appropriate role-based access control and database interactions using SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: List[RestaurantOut] list_restaurants( city: Optional[str] = None, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Public endpoint to list restaurants, optionally filtered by city.

methods.name: RestaurantOut get_restaurant(restaurant_id: UUID, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Public endpoint to fetch details of a specific restaurant by ID.

methods.name: RestaurantOut create_restaurant( payload: RestaurantCreate, user: AuthUser = Depends(require_roles("restaurant", "admin")), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Allows authorized users (restaurant owners or admins) to create a new restaurant record.

methods.name: RestaurantOut update_restaurant( restaurant_id: UUID, payload: RestaurantUpdate, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Allows restaurant owner or admin to update details of a specific restaurant.

methods.name: dict delete_restaurant( restaurant_id: UUID, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Allows owner or admin to delete a restaurant.
